definitions.explanation: A professional photography studio where portraits, family photos, and commemorative photographs are taken.

examples.japanese: {写真館|しゃしんかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: We had a family photo taken at a photo studio.

examples.japanese: ⟦{七五三|しちごさん}→七五三：06185_shichigosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{写真館|しゃしんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I booked a photo studio for our Shichi-Go-San commemoration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{写真館|しゃしんかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{撮|と}って→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The photo studio in front of the station also takes ID photos.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{写真館|しゃしんかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{振袖|ふりそで}→振袖：19967_furisode⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people have their furisode photos taken at a studio before Coming of Age Day.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ (photograph) + ⟦{館|かん}→館：17308_kan⟧ (hall/building). Photo studios in Japan are commonly used for milestone events: ⟦{七五三|しちごさん}→七五三：06185_shichigosan⟧, ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧, weddings, school entrance ceremonies, and graduation. They differ from casual photo printing shops in that they offer professional lighting, backdrops, and sometimes costume rental.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写真館|しゃしんかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: have a photo taken at a studio
- {写真館|しゃしんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: book a photo studio
- ⟦{記念|きねん}{写真|しゃしん}→記念写真：23222_kinenshashin⟧: commemorative photo
- ⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: ID/passport photo
- {前撮|まえど}り: advance photo session (before the event)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- フォトスタジオ: photo studio (modern/trendy branding)
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: photo shop (can also mean a casual print shop)
